Chapter 6172: Think Too Highly Of Yourself

Chapter 6172: Think Too Highly Of Yourself

Immortal Suppressor’s eyes narrowed after hearing this. As for the crowd, jaws nearly dropped to the ground.

“Only one Li Qiye in Sin.” A desolate god murmured.

Li Qiye wanted to destroy Immortal Suppression Dynasty just because he didn’t like Immortal Suppressor? What a ridiculous reason.

Anyone else would have been ridiculed for the outrageous and arrogant comment, but his words suffocated all listeners including Immortal Suppressor. If he raised his voice just a little, he could break their necks.

This was Li Qiye - just his casual words alone frightened the crowd.

“Dao Brother, is there a misunderstanding between us? What I’ve done is watch over this world under the command of my master. Although I am an unworthy disciple who has learned so little from him, I still tried my best. Thus, I apologize if I have offended you in some way.” Immortal Suppressor said, not losing his composure in the slightest.

Silence took over Sin due to the new information revealed. The rumor of his being Moshi’s disciple has always been credible. However, there was no concrete evidence; others didn’t know of his rank either.

Some said that he was only an outer disciple or had only been briefly guided by Moshi - a clear distinction between this and a direct disciple.

Therefore, the majority of their disciples were in Supreme Heaven while Immortal Suppressor remained in Sin. Alas, given his response just now, he might have been a direct disciple with the full backing of Supreme Heaven.

“A cheap apology, not worth a single coin.” Li Qiye shook his head.

Immortal Suppressor’s expression soured and stars gathered in his eyes.

“What else do you suggest, Dao Brother? Immortal Suppression is already destroyed.” Immortal Suppressor said.

Everyone found his demeanor to be surprising. He seemed eager to apologize to Li Qiye instead of avenging his fallen emperors and dynasty.

“Is this a joke?” A big shot thought he was hearing things.

“This doesn’t make any sense, did the emperors die in vain?” One desolate god remarked.

“Everything can be abandoned.” An emperor took a deep breath.

The dead apex emperors were powerful, especially Transcendent. They could have left but chose to stay to defend Immortal Suppression Dynasty. This ended with their death. However, the dynasty’s founder watched them die and wanted to appease their killer.

Some had gloated at the destruction of Immortal Suppression but felt sorry for the emperors now. They put themselves in the emperors’ shoes and found it frustrating. How unacceptable would it be for their sacrifice to be casually dismissed?

“A proper apology requires you to die.” Li Qiye smiled.

Immortal Suppressor’s expression turned dark while others smiled wryly.

“Dao Brother, I am being sincere here, hoping to mend all grievances. You are being unreasonable.” Immortal Suppressor released his aura and forced everyone to the ground.

“As I’ve said, you think too highly of yourself.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Killing me won’t change anything, not the current ways of Three Immortals.” He retorted.

“Too many unnecessary words, get down here!” Li Qiye reached for the lotus throne.

Immortal Suppressor roared and the throne became radiant. Each petal flew forward like divine blades, capable of cutting down emperors.

“Bam!” Li Qiye’s hand crushed all of them.

“Heaven Seal!” Immortal Suppressor’s primal anima emerged and the world’s powers became his.

His right hand could seal the heaven while his left could seal immortals. The absolute suppression caused Sin to cave down. All living beings became immobilized regardless of their location.

“So this is the might of a primal anima!” Emperors and desolate gods couldn’t move just like everyone else.
